# Dr. Sheesha Dubai

> Premium shisha lounge in Al Karama, Dubai, UAE.

## About

Dr. Sheesha is a premium shisha (hookah) lounge offering exotic flavours, craft drinks, food, and private events. Open daily from 12:00 PM to 6:00 AM.

## Location

- Address: Dr Sheesha, 112 Za'abeel St — Al Karama, Dubai, UAE
- Coordinates: 25.2481, 55.3066
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Dr+Sheesha+Al+Karama+Dubai
- Hours: Daily, 12:00 PM – 6:00 AM
